description_en: Starts a trail to begin event delivery of ActionTrail management events to OSS or Simple Log Service (SLS)
description_zh: 启用跟踪，开始将操作审计事件投递到 OSS 或 SLS
name: StartLogging

parameters.help_en:
The name of the trail to start.

The name must be 6 to 36 characters in length and must start with a lowercase letter. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

Trail names must be unique within the same account
parameters.help_zh:
要启用的跟踪名称。  
长度为6～36个字符，必须以小写英文字母开头，可包含小写英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

同一个账号内跟踪名称不可重复。
parameters.name: name
